name: nolte-linux
description: Linux image and appliance development for repositories that build bootable operating-system images: a toolchain-neutral image audit (mkosi, Yocto/Buildroot, Debian builders, NixOS/OSTree, bootc) covering pinned inputs, per-machine identity, update and rollback, SBOM, and boot-chain integrity, an image-definition developer, and VM boot verification. Adopt this on top of nolte-shared only if your repository builds Linux images or appliances; boot verification needs QEMU and UEFI firmware on the host.
